title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: When to scrimmage
hook: Do you save the scrimmage for last?
intro: Kids ask for the scrimmage all practice.
You hold it as the reward.
statement: Where the scrimmage goes changes how practice feels.
q1: Do you scrimmage at the end as the reward —
q2: or in the middle, then fix what you saw?
q3: What do you see in the scrimmage you could practice next?
t1: Both can work. But practice teaches more
t2: when the scrimmage connects to the drills.
ctaLines: At the end. In the middle. Twice, short.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do you save the scrimmage for last?
Kids ask for the scrimmage all practice. You hold it as the reward.
Where the scrimmage goes changes how practice feels.
Scrimmage at the end or in the middle. There is no perfect answer.
When do you scrimmage? Share your habit in the comments.
